programme.title: War Dogs
programme.desc: The Wolf of Wall Street's Jonah Hill and Whiplash's Miles Teller star in this dramedy based on a true story that follows two twenty-something Miami stoners who exploit a little-known government initiative during the Iraq War that allows small businesses to bid on U.S. Military contracts. Starting small, they begin raking in big money and are soon living the high life. But the pair gets in over their heads when they land a $300 million deal to arm the Afghan Military -- a deal that puts them in business with some very shady people, not the least of which turns out to be the U.S. Government. Comedy powerhouse Todd Phillips (The Hangover films) writes, directs and produces (with Bradley Cooper) this incredible true story based on a controversial Rolling Stone article.

But when a ruthless villain (The Lord of the Rings' Andy Serkis) from a rare children's fable kidnaps Meggie's father to bring others out of the boundaries of fiction, she and a disparate group of friends both real and magic embark on the kind of adventure she has only read about in books to save him and set things right. programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.111: Shrunken Ships / The Pirate Parade
programme.desc: When Escarlata turns the crew tiny, they have to find a pint-sized way to save the day. // It's time for the annual Pirate Parade! That is, unless Escarlata has anything to say about it.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.110: The Enchanted Melody / Chicken Abuelo
programme.desc: When Escarlata gets ahold of an enchanted guitar riff, all of the underseas may soon fall under her spell. // Tomás accidentally turns Abuelo into a chicken!

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S5 Ep.504: Camp Clue Hits the Trail!
programme.desc: Welcome back to Camp Clue! Josh really wants the Hiking Badge, which he can earn by hiking to Sparkle Falls... if he can find it! He plays Blue's Clues to figure out Sparkle Falls' secret location as he explores a mountain on our search for clues.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.731: The Market
programme.desc: Peppa and family find some great things to buy from the market and even get a special gift from Mr. Fox's stall.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.732: Peppa Goes to Paris
programme.desc: Peppa and family go on an exciting trip to Paris to see the sights and meet Delphine Donkey and her family.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.733: George's New Clothes
programme.desc: George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand new clothes.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.734: Madame Gazelle's House
programme.desc: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.735: Grandpa Pig's Pond
programme.desc: Peppa, George are helping Grandpa pig to dig a brand new pond for his garden!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.736: Tiny Land
programme.desc: It's time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.737: Long Train Journey
programme.desc: Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.738: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Peppa and family go on a walk through the forests where they meet all their favourite fairytale characters.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.739: Police Station
programme.desc: Oh, no! George has lost Mr. Dinosaur! Maybe the police can help George find him.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.740: Suzy Sheep Goes Away
programme.desc: Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.741: Stamps
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig is showing Peppa and George his extensive stamp collection, which inspires them to send a postcard of their own!

programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.407: The Secret Pyramid / Abuela Adventure Day
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, and Mami search for magical gems and a secret pyramid with their new friend, Patli! // Dora and friends save their Abuelas in time to celebrate Abuela Adventure Day!

programme.title: Dora S2 Ep.204: The Floor Is Guava
programme.desc: Now there's more to explore with DORA! Join the iconic exploradora in amazing adventures with friends old and new as she journeys across the wacky and wonderful Rainforest with her best friend Boots by her side.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S2 Ep.205: Just Gigi / Croc and Seek
programme.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile think Gigi is lonely, and try to spend every minute with her. // Mr. Crocodile hides Teddy's stuffed animal during hide and seek, then can't find it.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.217: Paper Landscapes / Cowgirl
programme.desc: Barbamama and Barbapapa are surprised to see more and more billboards on the road. // Barbalala dreams of becoming a cowgirl and Barbidou is determined to help her.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.108: Marvelous Moustaches
programme.desc: Barbazoo collects photos of moustached celebrities. Unfortunately, it's impossible to find the last one: Charles Horseshoe-Furlip. He suspects a conspiracy...

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.111: The Crew & Marshall Build A Fire Station
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build Builder Cove's first ever Fire Station, complete with an inspection from Paw Patrol's Marshall! But when Speed Meister's sneaky sabotage traps Marshall's Fire Truck, the pups work together to put out a fire construction-style.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.226: The Crew Builds A Lifeguard Tower
programme.desc: It's the perfect beach day in Builder Cove! If Rubble & Crew can build a lifeguard tower so the beach can open...

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1310: Pups Save a Grump-A-Saurus
programme.desc: Humdinger and Helga visit Dino Island, and get trapped in a cave. The pups have to save everyone before hot lava spills!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1313: Pups Save a Squirrely Cabin
programme.desc: Mischievous squirrels have made a plan take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.310: Pups Save a Stinky Flower
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger drops off a ‘gift’ to Mayor Goodway, a flower that spreads a horrible stink when it blooms.

programme.desc: Three contestants compete on arrow-word grids that they try to fill in by finding the answers to the given clues. But to access the clues, they must first answer questions with a very particular characteristic: the answer is always a letter.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Une Brique Dans Le Ventre
programme.desc: In addition to opening the doors to interiors of every style, this Belgian home magazine offers technical, legal and DIY advice, as well as ideas for weekend getaways.

programme.title: Escapades En Suisse Italienne Ep.5: Via del Ceneri
programme.desc: After refreshing ourselves and warming up with a few exercises, we head to Cadenazzo, on the educational and cultural route of the Via del Ceneri.

programme.title: Le Petit Geek Ep.5: Internet technologies
programme.desc: What exactly does an influencer do? How do you create a video game? Why are screens dangerous, and what about digital identities? In each episode children shed light on today's virtual world.

programme.title: Idéfix Et Les Irréductibles Ep.34: Bélénos isn't happy
programme.desc: 52 before JC. The city of Lutecia is occupied by the Romans... Completely? No! A gang of invincible animals led by Idéfix resist the invader again and again and its plans to romanise the city.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi Ep.46: Beneath the bowling alley
programme.desc: Olive, Pétole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: Billy Le Hamster Cowboy Ep.21: The kite battle
programme.desc: Billy grew up in the Far West. He already has his cowboy outfit and has a burning desire to go on great adventures! With his inseparable friends, Jean-Claude, the earthworm, and Suzie, the little ferret, they're off to face situations as thorny as a cactus.

programme.title: Drazilion Ep.47: The shell of the Moon
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: Enquêtes De Région
programme.desc: Travels to discover the regions of France. Through these territories, the investigations come as close as possible to the issues of today's society.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Les Gens D'À Côté
programme.desc: Haunted by the memory of her partner's suicide, Lucie, a forensic scientist nearing retirement, lives in a suburban housing estate. His solitary daily routine is disrupted by the arrival nearby of a couple, Julia and Yann, parents of a little girl, Rose. Bonds are forged...

programme.title: Résilience
programme.desc: After the death of his brother, Djibril goes through a difficult period. While taking care of his nephew, he will try to rebuild his life.

programme.title: La Photographe
programme.desc: France, 1936. The German photojournalist Gerta Pohorylle and her partner, the Hungarian photographer André Friedmann, had a hard time getting published in the press. When the Spanish Civil War broke out, they were determined to cover the events, under the names of Gerda Taro and Robert Capa.

programme.title: Mégantic Ep.3: The Lamarre family
programme.desc: Vincent tries to take a step back and to calm the distress of his family following the disaster. Despite his positive attitude, he sometimes thinks about ending it all. Before the tragedy, celebrations are in order for the Lamarre family, but they don't last long.

programme.title: Mégantic Ep.4: Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan, a volunteer fireman, was on the front line of the catastrophe. He was very badly shaken and succumbs to depression. He gets back in touch with Myriam, his childhood sweetheart. His relationship with his current girlfriend becomes tense.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi Ep.19: Fashion special
programme.desc: Haute couture has once again given free rein to its boldest ideas: a look back at the Autumn/Winter 2026-2027 shows and a tour of Paris, Fashion Week style. Radical designs, a fresh take on everyday wardrobes, the Spring/Summer 2027 menswear look is set to change! The evidence from Men's Fashion Week.
